Measurement contract and raw report

Each pass starts with a fresh public workspace. Cold fixture construction, context preparation, first main and ghost evaluations, and first render are reported separately. Steady frames vary angles or a synthetic live basis. The optional single-curve workload prepares one frozen gesture-start Drawing and an existing production handle-edit plan, then measures fresh native handle targets from that same source. Its source preparation and per-frame target cost are separate. Exactly one curve changes; all other source geometry and relations are asserted unchanged outside measured work. It uses zero ghosts and is not a recording inverse-edit benchmark. Main evaluation forces lazy drawing and paint products before rendering; ghosts reuse the production controls-only sampler.

Combined, evaluation-only, and pre-evaluated render-only passes use the same semantic frames. Render-only includes path generation, React reconciliation, and DOM commit, but excludes preparation and sampling. React Profiler reports subtree render time. The synchronous flush residual includes DOM commit and instrumentation overhead; it is not a pure DOM measurement.

requestAnimationFrame reports frame opportunities only. It does not establish actual paint completion, input-to-paint latency, dropped frames, or FPS. Keep this foreground tab visible. Production profiling adds overhead. No GPU speedup is measured by this CPU/SVG baseline.
